# Recorded archive search responses

Recorded on 2026-10-11 from the public Wikimedia Commons API and the Openverse API (query
`lisbon tram`, and a nonsense query for the empty cases), then trimmed to the fields the engine reads.
Entries marked `"_edited": true` are copies of a recorded entry with the licence changed, so the
licence filter (S7) sees NC, ND, GFDL, CC0, public-domain and unknown licences. Attribution data
(titles, authors, licence links) is the public CC licence metadata of the files.
